card.name: Words completing tricky or obstructive phrases
card.fires_on: The word that completes a phrase about hiding, evading, obstructing or making something easier or harder, such as 'off screen', 'in the air', 'trumped-up' or 'making it difficult'. It is strongest on 'screen' in 'positioned off screen'.

modes.label: Hidden or evasive wording
modes.description: Final word of an idiom about hiding, faking or shooting away, such as off screen, in the air, trumped-up.
modes.example: or positioned off<< screen>>. Another method gives a different page depending

modes.label: Making something easier or harder
modes.description: Adjective or verb right after 'making it' or 'to' that describes obstructing or easing an action.
modes.example: a Washington state policy making it<< difficult>> to buy potatoes with food-assistance coupons

card.plain: It fires on the last word of phrases about hiding, blocking or making something easier or harder to do.
